newsitem.title: INDIA: Factors besides MAT affected markets --India PM.
newsitem.headline: Factors besides MAT affected markets --India PM.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said on Monday that a minimum alternate tax (MAT) proposed by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in his last budget was not the only factor that had depressed stockmarket sentiment.
"MAT is not the only reason," Deve Gowda told a meeting of about 900 delegates attending an infrastructure seminar in Bombay. "There are so many other reasons also."
The tax was designed to draw into the federal tax net some of India's largest companies which have avoided paying taxes because they said they ploughed their profits into new projects.
But Gowda refused to elaborate further, saying that it was too close to the next budget for him to make any comments.
Chidambaram is due to present the budget for fiscal 1996/97 (April/March) on February 28.
